public_open_space.description: This large plaza space features extensive rock landscaping and artwork. There are two adjoined areas, one of which has food service.

public_art.title: Big Bertha
public_art.art_requirement_note: Predates the 1985 Downtown Plan; the art was provided under approvals guided by the pending plan.
public_art.detail: The granite boulder sits in a POPOS between the office towers that also displays poetry by U.S. Poet Laureate Robert Hass. Paul Kos, born December 23, 1942, is an American artist.
